import asyncio
import json
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

WORKSPACE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
START_URL = 'http://ec2-18-223-172-69.us-east-2.compute.amazonaws.com:7780/admin'
TARGET_PRODUCT = 'Circe Hooded Ice Fleece'


def next_run_dir(root: Path) -> Path:
    final_runs = root / 'final_runs'
    final_runs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    ids = []
    for p in final_runs.glob('run_*'):
        try:
            ids.append(int(p.name.split('_')[1]))
        except Exception:
            pass
    run_id = max(ids, default=0) + 1
    run_dir = final_runs / f'run_{run_id:03d}'
    (run_dir / 'screenshots').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return run_dir


async def safe_goto(page, url, wait_until='domcontentloaded', attempts=3):
    last_exc = None
    for _ in range(attempts):
        try:
            await page.goto(url, wait_until=wait_until, timeout=60000)
            return
        except Exception as e:
            last_exc = e
            await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    raise last_exc


async def login(page, log):
    await safe_goto(page, START_URL, wait_until='domcontentloaded')
    if await page.locator('input[type="password"]').count() > 0:
        log('step 1 action: authenticate into Magento admin with provided credentials')
        await page.locator('input[name="login[username]"], input[name="username"], input[type="text"]').first.fill('admin')
        await page.locator('input[name="login[password]"], input[name="password"], input[type="password"]').first.fill('admin1234')
        btn = page.get_by_role('button', name='Sign in').first
        if await btn.count():
            await btn.click()
        else:
            await page.locator('input[type="password"]').first.press('Enter')
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    else:
        log('step 1 action: admin page already authenticated; no login needed')


async def main():
    run_dir = next_run_dir(WORKSPACE)
    shots = run_dir / 'screenshots'
    log_path = run_dir / 'final_script_log.txt'
    response_path = WORKSPACE / 'agent_response.json'
    data = []

    def log(msg: str):
        with log_path.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.write(msg + '\n')
        print(msg)

    log_path.write_text('', encoding='utf-8')
    (run_dir / 'final_script.py').write_text(Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'), encoding='utf-8')

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 1280, 'height': 1800})
        page = await context.new_page()
        page.set_default_timeout(60000)
        page.set_default_navigation_timeout(60000)

        await login(page, log)
        await page.screenshot(path=str(shots / 'final_execution_1_after_login.png'))
        log(f'step 2 action: confirmed dashboard access at {page.url}')

        await safe_goto(page, 'http://ec2-18-223-172-69.us-east-2.compute.amazonaws.com:7780/admin/review/product/', wait_until='networkidle')
        name_filter = page.locator('#reviewGrid_filter_name')
        await name_filter.fill(TARGET_PRODUCT)
        await name_filter.press('Enter')
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        await page.screenshot(path=str(shots / 'final_execution_2_filtered_reviews_grid.png'))
        rows = await page.locator('tbody tr').count()
        log(f'step 3 action: filtered All Reviews grid by product name {TARGET_PRODUCT}; visible rows count {rows}')

        matching_rows = page.locator('tbody tr', has_text=TARGET_PRODUCT)
        count = await matching_rows.count()
        log(f'step 4 action: identified {count} review rows for the target product in the filtered grid')
        reviews_to_check = []
        for i in range(count):
            row = matching_rows.nth(i)
            rid_text = await row.locator('td').nth(1).inner_text()
            title_text = await row.locator('td').nth(4).inner_text()
            reviews_to_check.append({'rid': rid_text.strip(), 'title': title_text.strip()})
        log(f'step 4 action: collected review ids from grid {reviews_to_check}')

        for i, review in enumerate(reviews_to_check):
            rid = review['rid']
            title = review['title']
            detail_url = f'http://ec2-18-223-172-69.us-east-2.compute.amazonaws.com:7780/admin/review/product/edit/id/{rid}/'
            await safe_goto(page, detail_url, wait_until='networkidle')
            product = (await page.locator('a[href*="catalog/product/edit"], .admin__field:has-text("Product") .admin__field-value').first.inner_text()).strip()
            checked_id = await page.locator('input[type="radio"]:checked').first.get_attribute('id')
            summary_style = await page.locator('.rating-box .rating').first.get_attribute('style') or ''
            rating = checked_id.split('_')[-1] if checked_id else ''
            await page.screenshot(path=str(shots / f'final_execution_{5+i}_review_{rid}_detail.png'))
            log(f'step {5+i} action: opened review id {rid} detail page for product {product}; extracted title {title}; checked rating widget id {checked_id}; summary style {summary_style}')
            if product == TARGET_PRODUCT and rating and int(rating) <= 3:
                data.append({'title': title, 'rating': rating})
                log(f'step {5+i} action: included review id {rid} because rating {rating} is 3 stars or below')
            else:
                log(f'step {5+i} action: excluded review id {rid} because product/rating does not satisfy target criteria; rating={rating}')

        await browser.close()

    status = 'SUCCESS' if data else 'NOT_FOUND_ERROR'
    payload = {
        'task_type': 'RETRIEVE',
        'status': status,
        'retrieved_data': data if data else None,
        'error_details': None,
    }
    response_path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    log(f'step 9 action: wrote agent_response.json with payload {json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)}')
    log(f'final response data: {json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False)}')
    print(json.dumps({'run_dir': str(run_dir), 'payload': payload}, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())

from pathlib import Path
import json, re, shutil
from urllib.request import build_opener, HTTPCookieProcessor, Request
from urllib.parse import urlencode
from http.cookiejar import CookieJar

WORKSPACE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
RUN_DIR = WORKSPACE / 'final_runs' / 'run_1'
SCREENSHOTS = RUN_DIR / 'screenshots'
LOG = RUN_DIR / 'final_script_log.txt'
AGENT_RESPONSE = WORKSPACE / 'agent_response.json'
BASE = 'http://ec2-18-223-172-69.us-east-2.compute.amazonaws.com:7780/admin/'
PENDING_URL = 'http://ec2-18-223-172-69.us-east-2.compute.amazonaws.com:7780/admin/review/product/pending/'
ALL_URL = 'http://ec2-18-223-172-69.us-east-2.compute.amazonaws.com:7780/admin/review/product/index/'

RUN_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
SCREENSHOTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
LOG.write_text('')


def log(msg):
    with LOG.open('a') as f:
        f.write(msg + '\n')
    print(msg)


def save_text_image(path: Path, text: str):
    try:
        from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
        img = Image.new('RGB', (1280, 1800), 'white')
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
        y = 20
        for raw in text.splitlines():
            line = raw[:150]
            draw.text((20, y), line, fill='black')
            y += 22
            if y > 1760:
                break
        img.save(path)
        return
    except Exception:
        pass
    svg = '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1280" height="1800"><rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="white"/>'
    y = 30
    for raw in text.splitlines()[:70]:
        esc = raw.replace('&', '&').replace('<', '<').replace('>', '>')
        svg += f'<text x="20" y="{y}" font-size="18" font-family="monospace" fill="black">{esc}</text>'
        y += 24
    svg += '</svg>'
    path.write_text(svg)


cj = CookieJar()
opener = build_opener(HTTPCookieProcessor(cj))
login_html = opener.open(BASE, timeout=30).read().decode('utf-8', 'ignore')
form_key = re.search(r'name="form_key" type="hidden" value="([^"]+)"', login_html).group(1)
log('step 1 action: Open Magento admin login page and extract form key for authentication.')
save_text_image(SCREENSHOTS / 'final_execution_1_open_login.png', 'Magento admin login page opened.\nForm key extracted successfully.\nURL: ' + BASE + '\nform_key: ' + form_key)

payload = urlencode({'form_key': form_key, 'login[username]': 'admin', 'login[password]': 'admin1234'}).encode()
resp = opener.open(Request(BASE, data=payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'}), timeout=30)
dashboard_html = resp.read().decode('utf-8', 'ignore')
dashboard_url = resp.geturl()
log(f'step 2 action: Submit admin credentials and reach authenticated admin page at {dashboard_url}.')
save_text_image(SCREENSHOTS / 'final_execution_2_after_login.png', 'Logged into Magento admin.\nFinal URL: ' + dashboard_url + '\nContains Pending Reviews link: ' + str('Pending Reviews' in dashboard_html) + '\nContains All Reviews link: ' + str('All Reviews' in dashboard_html))

all_html = opener.open(ALL_URL, timeout=30).read().decode('utf-8', 'ignore')
all_ids = sorted(set(re.findall(r'/admin/review/product/edit/id/(\d+)/', all_html)))
all_pages = re.search(r'of\s+(\d+)\s+Next page', re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', all_html), re.I)
log(f'step 3 action: Open All Reviews page to confirm review management listing; observed {len(all_ids)} rows on current page and pager text of {all_pages.group(1) if all_pages else "unknown"} pages.')
save_text_image(SCREENSHOTS / 'final_execution_3_all_reviews.png', 'All Reviews page opened.\nCurrent page unique review edit ids: ' + ', '.join(all_ids[:25]) + '\nPager pages: ' + (all_pages.group(1) if all_pages else 'unknown'))

pending_html = opener.open(PENDING_URL, timeout=30).read().decode('utf-8', 'ignore')
pending_ids = sorted(set(re.findall(r'/admin/review/product/edit/id/(\d+)/', pending_html)))
pending_count = len(pending_ids)
pending_title = re.search(r'<title>(.*?)</title>', pending_html, re.S)
pager = re.search(r'of\s+(\d+)\s+Next page', re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', pending_html), re.I)
log(f'step 4 action: Open dedicated Pending Reviews page and count unique pending review edit ids: {pending_ids} -> total pending reviews {pending_count}.')
save_text_image(SCREENSHOTS / 'final_execution_4_pending_reviews.png', 'Pending Reviews page opened.\nTitle: ' + (pending_title.group(1).strip() if pending_title else 'n/a') + '\nPending review IDs visible: ' + ', '.join(pending_ids) + '\nTotal pending reviews counted from unique visible rows: ' + str(pending_count) + '\nPager pages: ' + (pager.group(1) if pager else 'unknown'))

response = {
    'task_type': 'RETRIEVE',
    'status': 'SUCCESS',
    'retrieved_data': [pending_count],
    'error_details': None,
}
AGENT_RESPONSE.write_text(json.dumps(response))
log('step 5 action: Write agent_response.json with retrieved_data containing the pending review count [' + str(pending_count) + '].')
log('Final response data: ' + json.dumps(response))
save_text_image(SCREENSHOTS / 'final_execution_5_agent_response.png', 'agent_response.json written with:\n' + json.dumps(response, indent=2))

shutil.copy2(__file__, RUN_DIR / 'final_script.py')
